[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for a dresser with smooth-gliding drawers include:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for choosing a dresser include reading reviews, checking the warranty, and testing it out in-store.  
[PREFERENCE] User is concerned about the size of the dresser due to a small bedroom.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for measuring the room and finding a dresser that fits well include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Take precise measurements of the room and the space for the dresser.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Measure doorways and hallways to ensure the dresser can fit through.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Consider the scale of the dresser in relation to the room size.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Decide on the orientation of the dresser in the room.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Use online room planners or apps to visualize the space.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dresser size guidelines include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Standard width: 36-48 inches (91-122 cm); consider narrower options for small rooms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Typical depth: 18-20 inches (46-51 cm); look for smaller depths if space is limited.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Common height: 30-40 inches (76-102 cm); taller dressers can make a room feel smaller.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Consider compact or narrow dressers if space is extremely limited.
